lines.speaker: titoboy
lines.text: O, kaway kayo! Para kay Tatay Rudy 'to!
lines.caption: Come on, wave! This one's for Tatay Rudy!

lines.speaker: lola
lines.text: Pambaon mo, anak. Huwag mong gagastusin agad, ha.
lines.caption: Something for your trip, son. Don't spend it all at once.

lines.speaker: rudy
lines.caption: How does this work? What do I press?

lines.speaker: titoboy
lines.text: Wala. Basta huwag mo lang papatayin.
lines.caption: Nothing. Just don't turn it off.

lines.speaker: rudy
lines.text: Dito na lang. Picture tayo, lahat!
lines.caption: I'll leave it here. Photo, everybody!

lines.speaker: liza
lines.text: Nico, tumawag ulit 'yung bangko. Three months na tayong late.
lines.caption: Nico, the bank called again. We're three months behind.

lines.speaker: nico
lines.text: Alam ko. May papasok na pera, promise.
lines.caption: I know. Money's coming in. I promise.

lines.speaker: liza
lines.text: Galing saan? Diyan sa channel mo?
lines.caption: From where? That channel of yours?

lines.speaker: liza
lines.text: Eighteen hundred. Sa isang buwan. Nico… ibenta na lang natin 'yung shop. Please.
lines.caption: Eighteen hundred. In a month. Nico… let's sell the shop. Please.

lines.speaker: liza
lines.text: Pakainin mo si Bea. Bea, huwag mong hayaang magpuyat si Papa, okay?
lines.caption: Feed Bea. Bea, don't let Papa stay up late, okay?

lines.speaker: bea
lines.text: Pa, may box po sa labas. Nauulanan na po.
lines.caption: Pa, there's a box outside. It's getting rained on.

lines.speaker: bea
lines.text: Pa, iba po 'yung itsura ng pera.
lines.caption: Pa, the money looks different.

lines.speaker: nico
lines.text: Luma lang 'yan. Tatanggapin pa 'yan ng bank.
lines.caption: It's just old. The bank will still take it.

lines.speaker: nico
lines.text: Shh. Huwag mo munang sasabihin kay Mama, ha?
lines.caption: Shh. Don't tell Mama yet, okay?

lines.speaker: bea
lines.text: Sino po 'yung nakatayo sa may kusina?
lines.caption: Who's that standing by the kitchen?

lines.speaker: bea
lines.caption: It's been there the whole time.

lines.speaker: bea
lines.caption: Pa… are you going to post that?

lines.speaker: nico
lines.text: Tape one. No label. Walang pangalan.
lines.caption: Tape one. No label. No name.
